text:
maria_cs: Kicking off Lumenix QBR prep — they asked for a concise cost breakdown and an onboarding status snapshot by EOD Friday.

sam_finops: On it. I pulled the last 30d token burn: avg ~1.2M tokens/day, with a spike to ~2.3M during activation weekend. Need to verify which routes caused the spike (likely embeds).

eli_research: Spike aligns with the bulk ingest job hitting /v1/embeds (prod-v2). They were running parallel uploads without batching.

jess_onboard: Onboarding status: ~70% complete. Docs workshop scheduled Thu 10am, success manager logged 2 open asks: (1) routing to dedicated vs hosted, (2) how to use prefix caching.

maria_cs: Renewal risk flagged as "moderate" because actual spend exceeded their internal forecast last month. We need a short mitigation plan + 6-month spend forecast for the QBR.

sam_finops: I can produce the forecast. Quick SQL I'll run to build baseline: 
```
SELECT date, tokens FROM usage WHERE account = 'lumenix' AND date >= '2026-02-01'
```
I'll attach CSV and trend charts by 3pm Fri.

ops-bot: budget-alert: lumenix exceeded threshold on 3500012200 — notifications sent to @maria_cs and @sam_finops :warning:

maria_cs: Thanks. Sam — can you add two what-if scenarios: (A) enable KV prefix caching across ingestion routes, (B) enable caching + switch non-critical routes to q4 quant model?

eli_research: Quick notes: switching non-critical summarization routes to q4 historically drops token compute cost ~25% with a ~1-2% quality delta on abstractive summarization. Caching can be ~15-25% depending on prefix reuse.

jess_onboard: From enablement POV we should propose a 30-min session for Lumenix engineers on batching and prefix caching best practices; that usually cuts token churn significantly. I'll draft an invite + checklist.

sam_finops: Running three scenarios now: baseline, caching, caching+q4. Early estimates: baseline ~36M tokens/mo; caching ~-20% => ~28.8M; caching+q4 ~-38% => ~22.3M. Will convert tokens to USD using current unit rates and show monthly delta.

maria_cs: Great. Also capture feedback: they want per-route, per-team cost visibility in Console and the ability to tag routes to internal teams. Add that to the QBR asks.

eli_research: For the deck I can prepare a single-slide ops tradeoff: latency, quality, and unit-cost by model variant + recommended rollout plan (canary non-critical routes first).

jess_onboard: Action items (for the QBR deliverable):
- Sam: forecast CSV, what-if scenarios, and unit-cost numbers by 3pm Fri
- Eli: ops slide + model tradeoff notes by Tue
- Maria: compile CS speaking points, renewal ask framing, and mitigation plan by Fri
- Jess: enablement session draft + doc snippets and invite

maria_cs: Also tagging product for a potential temporary credit or small onboarding concession if it helps renewal — @sam_finops can you simulate a 3-month 15% credit scenario and show break-even? :thinking:

sam_finops: Will include concession simulation in the spreadsheet. Preliminary check: 15% credit over 3 months is expensive, but if it reduces churn probability and secures a dedicated commit next quarter it may be justified. I'll calculate net present value and margin impact.

maria_cs: OK team — quick sync 11:00 tomorrow to review the first-pass forecast and draft deck. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
